new_items.title: Research: identify FW14 kernel exploit blockers before active testing
new_items.summary: ## Obiettivo Preparare una ricerca riproducibile sulle routine AIO, senza lanciare exploit 13.52 non compatibili sulla PS4 Slim 14.00. ## Risultati - Documentazione **go/no-go** basata sul codice di Raw13G, sulle tabelle HEN 14.00 e sull'audit del prototipo `ps4-suid-scanner` (che lascia l'exploit userland non implementato). - Nuovo `tools/compare_aio_disassembly.py`: confronta le disassemblazioni di `aio_multi_wait`, `aio_multi_cancel`, ecc. *solo quando avremo i binari kernel decifrati e correttamente identificati*. - Test sintetici e GitHub Actions, nessuna modifica alla console. ## Limitazioni dichiarate I pacchetti PUP non permettono da soli di confermare la patch di Relapse. Nessun exploit kernel 14.00 è stato costruito, caricato o eseguito; nessun test pericoloso è avviato.
new_items.author: DanieleDellUomo

new_items.title: Research: compare PS4 13.52 and 14.00 PUP outer metadata
new_items.summary: ## Scope The uploaded PUPs are large and the current ChatGPT container could not read them; this PR adds a repeatable **read-only** comparator for local files. Also adds a GitHub Actions workflow that attempts to download matching official Sony packages and publish **JSON metadata only**. - SLB2 outer entry parser, SHA-256 of nested *encrypted* segments, whole-file MD5/SHA256 and exact sizes - Cross-check MD5 against the publicly documented firmware hashes - Three offline synthetic-container unit tests (all pass in GitHub Actions on the research branch) - Docs outlining that no kernel diff/decryption or Relapse patch confirmation can follow from encrypted-container metadata alone No Sony firmware binaries or exploit payloads are committed. This is not an FW 14.00 jailbreak.
new_items.author: DanieleDellUomo

items.title: Add safe runtime tests and PS4 13.52→14.00 firmware research
items.summary: Aggiunge una pagina di test funzionali **non invasivi** per il browser PS4 Slim 14.00 (TypedArray/DataView, Promise, Fetch stesso host, Worker, eccezioni), asset locali di prova e script di controllo PUP per PC. Documenta la differenza fra Relapse/AIO Multi Cancel pubblico su FW 13.52 e supporto HEN 14.00 senza kernel exploit pubblico. I PUP non sono inclusi e non sono stati scaricati nell'ambiente di analisi. Verifica offline dei controlli puri JS, nessuna prova ancora su console per questi nuovi test. Nessun payload, exploit, scansione memoria o telemetria. Il collegamento ai test è su diagnostics.html.

items.title: README e docs em inglês/português/espanhol, pesquisa de PKG/fPKG e correção do modo rápido do E2E
items.summary: ## README em três idiomas - `README.md` agora é em inglês, o padrão que o GitHub mostra. O português foi para `README.pt-BR.md` e há também `README.es.md`. - Cada README tem um seletor de idioma no topo. - A interface ainda é só em português (o inglês é a Fase 4). Por isso o inglês e o espanhol avisam isso e mostram os nomes dos botões como aparecem no app, com a tradução. ## Docs em três idiomas - `docs/en/` e `docs/es/` trazem arquitetura, FTP-PS5, testes, roadmap e PKG-PS5. - O português (`docs/*.md`) continua sendo o original. Todas as docs têm seletor de idioma, e cada README aponta para as docs no seu idioma. ## Pesquisa de PKG/fPKG e Fase 6 no roadmap - `docs/PKG-PS5.md` reúne, com fontes: - jailbreak por firmware (até o Relapse 7.00–13.60; 14.00 sem jailbreak público); - fPKG de PS4 e de PS5 por firmware (kstuff, kstuff 1.6.6 e kstuff-lite 1.11: o fPKG de PS5 só vai até 11.60); - instaladores de pacote: etaHEN DPI v1/v2, ezRemote DPI, pkg-sender, ps5upload; - formatos de imagem

items.title: Harden scanner bounds checks and correct research evidence
items.summary: ## Summary - Validate getdents entry lengths before reading names or advancing through the native buffer. - Reject overlong paths before copying into native buffers. - Abort scanning cleanly when required native functions are unavailable. - Detect incomplete USB report writes. - Correct documentation that overstates CVE/Orbis applicability; add public FreeBSD advisory and upstream-source references. - Mark PS4-specific kernel and MP4 claims as unconfirmed where the repository lacks reproducible evidence. - Preserve the current upstream README scope, including the 14.00 research files. ## Validation status Static review only. No CI workflow or runnable test suite was found in the public repository, and the BD-J scanner has not been run on target hardware. items.title: Opus 4.6 regression symptom 15: model forgets file paths and repo context within same conversation
items.summary: ## Follow-up to #96308 — Additional regression symptom ### Symptom 15: Model loses memory of file paths and repository context within the same conversation Since ~Sep 16, 2026, Claude no longer remembers basic context like file paths and repository locations that were established earlier in the same conversation. ### Example 1: Forgets repo paths When generating git commands for the user's own repositories, the model outputs generic placeholder paths like `~/ruta/ps4-suid-scanner` instead of the actual paths it previously knew. Before the regression, Claude remembered working directory paths throughout the conversation without the user having to repeat them. ### Example 2: Fails to check user's own repos before claiming something doesn't exist User asked about PS4 firmware 14.00 offsets. Claude stated the offsets don't exist in the scene, while the user had ALREADY committed 1400_offsets.txt to their own repo (adri22235/ps4-13xx-research) minutes earlier in the same session.
